_readme: TITAN CONFIG — single wallet. Edit values, click RELOAD CONFIG in UI.

MAX_BET_ABS._description: Hard cap on any single bet in USD. Lowered from 5.0 — protect bankroll.

MAX_BET_PCT._description: Max bet as fraction of current bankroll. Lowered from 0.20 to 0.12 to limit ruin risk.

KELLY_FRACTION._description: Fraction of full Kelly to use. Lowered from 0.25 to be more conservative.

MIN_TRADE_CASH._description: Min USD for public feed trades.

MAX_TRADES_FETCH._description: Max public feed trades per cycle.

HOT_HOURS._description: Trades within this many hours are HOT.

WARM_HOURS._description: Trades older than HOT but within this are WARM. Reduced from 6 to fix public feed limit hits.

HFT_POLL_LIMIT._description: Trades to fetch per HFT wallet per cycle. Raised from 50 to match ELITE_POLL_LIMIT — 0x6E1d and similar HFT elites were hitting the 50-trade wall.

HFT_MIN_TRADES_PER_HOUR._description: Minimum TPH to classify as HFT.

HFT_MIRROR_DELAY_MAX_SECONDS._description: Only mirror HFT trades placed within this many seconds.

HFT_SPIKE_MIN_ABS_CASH._description: HFT spike must be at least this many USD absolute. Reduced from 700 to catch more elite spikes.

HFT_SPIKE_MULTIPLIER_LOW._description: Spike multiplier for wallets with TPH <= 200. Raised from 20 to be more selective.

HFT_SPIKE_MULTIPLIER_HIGH._description: Spike multiplier for wallets with TPH > 200. Raised from 30.

ELITE_POLL_LIMIT._description: Trades to fetch per elite wallet per cycle. Raised from 50 — fast traders were hitting limit.

ELITE_POLL_MIN_CASH._description: Min USD per trade when polling elites.

ELITE_TRADE_MIN_FRACTION._description: Elite trade must be >= this fraction of their avg_bet. Lowered from 0.05 to catch more trades.

MAX_SIGNAL_AGE_H._description: Max signal age in hours. Relaxed to 1.0h to stop blocking valid 35-60 min old whale trades.

MIN_SCORE._description: Min score to appear in signals list. Lowered to 45 to allow borderline valid single-elite signals through.

ALERT_SCORE._description: Score threshold for ALERT tier / auto-traded. Lowered from 65 to 60 to allow more high-quality signals to auto-trade.

MIN_CONFLUENCE._description: Min verified whales buying same side.

MAX_DRIFT._description: Skip if price > whale avg entry by this fraction. Relaxed from 0.06.

MIN_DRIFT._description: Skip if price < whale avg entry by this fraction. Relaxed from -0.10.

MAX_ENTRY_SLIPPAGE._description: Max slippage above elite entry. Relaxed from 0.04.

HFT_MAX_DRIFT._description: Stricter max drift for HFT spike signals.

HFT_MIN_DRIFT._description: Stricter min drift for HFT spike signals.

STALE_LOSER_AGE_H._description: If signal this old AND losing, skip.

STALE_LOSER_DRIFT._description: Drift threshold for stale loser check.

MIN_LIQUIDITY._description: Min USD liquidity. Lowered from 5000 to open more markets.

MIN_HOURS_LEFT._description: Skip markets closing in fewer hours than this.

MIN_WIN_RATE_WATCH._description: Min win rate to be watchable.

MIN_WIN_RATE_VER._description: Min win rate to be verified.

MIN_RESOLVED_BETS._description: Min resolved bets to be scored.

MIN_PNL._description: Min lifetime PnL to be watchable.

WILSON_MIN_WATCH._description: Wilson lower bound min to be watchable.

WILSON_MIN_VER._description: Wilson lower bound min to be verified.

MIN_AVG_PROFIT_PER_TRADE._description: Min avg profit per trade USD.

ELITE_MIN_PNL._description: Elite requires lifetime PnL >= this USD.

ELITE_MIN_PORT._description: Elite requires portfolio proxy >= this USD.

ELITE_MIN_RESOLVED._description: Elite requires at least this many resolved bets.

LARGE_TRADE._description: Single trade >= this USD is large.

MASSIVE_TRADE._description: Single trade >= this USD is massive.

MAX_POSITIONS_PER_EVENT._description: Max positions sharing the same eventSlug.

MAX_POSITIONS_PER_WHALE._description: Max open positions per single elite whale. Set to 1 to prevent double-betting on same whale's signals (e.g. 3x Sinner bets, 2x BTC bets from 0x6E1d).

PROFIT_TARGET_PCT._description: Auto-sell when position is up this fraction.

WHALE_EXIT_SELL._description: Exit when the original triggering whale sells.

STOP_LOSS_ENABLED._description: Enable stop-loss independent of whale moves.

STOP_LOSS_PCT._description: Stop-loss threshold for non-sports. Sports use -0.25 hardcoded. Politics: -0.45.

EXIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS._description: Cooldown after closing a position before re-entering same market.

DISCOVERY_INTERVAL_CYCLES._description: Run whale discovery every N cycles.

MARKET_TTL._description: Market data cache TTL in seconds.

ACTIVITY_LIMIT._description: Max activity records for win rate.

vip_wallets._description: Polled every single cycle regardless of elite status.

wallets.note: neutralwave23 — HFT spike trader, 362-461x avg on Bitcoin ATH markets

seed_watchlist._description: Wallets added to watchlist on first boot.
